headline: One photo, 149 different works
reasons: The same photo file (fingerprint dc42c581e938) is attached to 149 different works in 4 villages. A photo of one site cannot be evidence for 149 separate works.
The works are recorded as: Contour Trench (149).
These works are spread over 4 blocks: Dakore, Kadaura, Kuthaund, Maheva.
